free_tier.stated: none: no free plan and no self-serve price. Last published seat prices, as archived on 2026-09-18 before tabnine.com/pricing began redirecting to a Tricentis sales form: 59 per user per month for the Agentic Platform (the tier that lists the Tabnine CLI) and 39 per user per month for the Code Assistant Platform, both annual subscriptions by quote; the 39 is USD ($39/user/month on the vendor's comparison page) and the page prints no currency symbol beside the 59. Headless Agents add-on, as archived on 2026-08-04: 1,200 per month (up to 5B tokens) or 5000 per month (up to 50B tokens)
free_tier.notes: no price is published today; the current Tricentis-era price is unverified: behind a sales quote

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a coding subscription meters no stored object

egress.terms: not applicable: no egress term is published; model usage is the metered unit

interface_detail: Headless: `tabnine -p "prompt"` with optional `--output-format json`, authenticated by the TABNINE_TOKEN environment variable holding a Personal Access Token made in the Tabnine console; an admin toggle can block auto-approve (YOLO) in headless mode. The OpenCode-based successor runs `tabnine run "prompt"` with `--model tabnine/<key>` and `--format json`, and rejects ask-first tool prompts when there is no UI. The original CLI is in maintenance mode, with critical updates only through December 31, 2026
tooling: the Tabnine Agent in IDEs, Tabnine Chat, and the Tabnine CLI (`tabnine`, a Node.js program installed from the organisation's Tabnine host once an admin has enabled Agents); the CLI's successor is the Tabnine plugin for OpenCode. Models: the AI Models page lists Claude 4.8 Opus down to Claude 4 Sonnet, GPT-5.5 down to GPT-4o, Gemini 3.5 Pro, 3.1 Pro and 3.0 Pro, Devstral Small 2 and Devstral 2, MiniMax-M2.7, GLM-4.7, Qwen-3-Coder-480B-A35B-Instruct and Qwen-3-30B (chat only); the page's table merges its Thinking Model and Tabnine CLI columns, so which of these the CLI serves is unverified; an Enterprise admin can also attach the organisation's own model…
chaining: none: there is no free capacity to chain. Model usage through Tabnine-provided access is billed at the model provider's price plus a 5% handling fee, or is unlimited on the organisation's own LLM endpoint; compare the other hosted subscriptions in coding-subs, which a single developer can buy without a sales contract

limits.value: accounts can only be set up together with the Tabnine team; the only route to a price is a sales conversation
1 billion tokens a month fair-use limit for each regular user
Service Accounts for pipelines: 5 billion tokens a month (Business tier) or 50 billion tokens a month (Enterprise tier), licensed separately from user seats

limits_note: a seat covers one user, and CI/CD runs go through separately licensed Service Accounts; admins can also set monthly monetary caps per organisation, team and user
binding_note: the plan is reachable only through a sales conversation, so no quota is reachable by one person with an email

identity_cost.detail: a sales-led enterprise contract: Enterprise (SaaS) accounts can only be set up together with the Tabnine team, and tabnine.com/pricing redirects to a Tricentis 'Talk with a sales expert' contact form; no self-serve signup and no card flow

reliability_note: the vendor was acquired by Tricentis on 2026-07-30 and its public pricing pages now redirect to Tricentis; the original CLI is in maintenance mode, with critical updates only through 2026-12-31
confidence_note: the seat prices are the last published ones, read from archived copies of the vendor's pages dated 2026-09-18 and 2026-08-04; the plan, signup gate, CLI headless mode, models and token limits are read from the vendor's documentation on 2026-11-02
